summary: The benchmarks are holding modest gains into the afternoon and volatility is easing, but midcaps and smallcaps slipped slightly lower, so the lift is narrow and led by large caps.

detail.leaders: Axis Bank, M&M, HCLTech; realty and autos; Whirlpool India
detail.laggards: Midcaps (−0.29%) and smallcaps (−0.09%); IT names (OFSS, Infosys)
detail.tone: Much the same as noon: the Sensex is still about 100–150 points higher and the Nifty is near 23,080, while India VIX has dropped 7.25% to 11.77. That is a sign traders are pricing out Thursday's panic even though broader buying is thin.
